svg.title: Thus every conclusive time is unambiguous. A null result filters the surviving quantum source, and the predetermined reader compensates exactly for that filter. No fresh independence is inferred. This bounded-hazard construction is also optimal in its own model class. For any absorbing two-port unambiguous instrument with Q(t) ≤κI, the no-transition matrix satisfies N(t)∗N(t) ≥e−κtI, since d dt(N∗N) = −N∗QN ≥−κN∗N. With average cumulative success ̄q(t), (6) gives
